summary: Netflix filed an 8-K announcing its Board authorized an additional $25 billion share repurchase program, supplementing the December 2024 authorization. As of March 31, 2026, approximately $6.8 billion remained under the prior program. Repurchases may be executed via open-market transactions (Rule 10b-18), 10b5-1 plans, privately-negotiated deals, accelerated stock repurchases, or block trades, with no expiration date and no obligation to repurchase any specific number of shares. Management retains discretion on timing and amount, subject to market conditions and alternative opportunities. The company may discontinue repurchases without notice. Watch for execution pace and impact on share count and EPS.
